stem: What is the best summary of the play?

options.label: F
options.text: A boy is humiliated when he forgets the words to the national anthem while singing at a football game, but his friend helps him understand that many people have made similar mistakes.

options.label: G
options.text: A boy is surprised to learn that he was filmed while singing the national anthem, but his friend promises to erase the recording.

options.label: H
options.text: A boy is angry when he finishes singing the national anthem at a football game, but his friend persuades him to sing a different song later so that he can feel better.

options.label: J
options.text: A boy is upset when he forgets the words to the national anthem, but his friend compliments his voice and makes him feel better.
